title: Earnings Season, AI & Oil Prices in Focus
text: The Close brings you the latest news and analysis leading up to the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street. Today's guests are RockCreek CEO & Founder Afsaneh Beschloss, Barclays Multi-Sector Aerospace & Defense Analyst Anthony Valentini, Former Fed Governor Betsy Duke, Robinhood Markets CIO Stephanie Guild, Inflation Insights Founder & President Omair Sharif, Gabelli Funds Portfolio Manager Macrae Skyes, & Neostellar Principal Willy Lee. (Source: Bloomberg)
